bookman purchased 55 copies of a new book released recently , 10 of which are hardback and sold for $ 20 each , and rest are paperback and sold for $ 10 each . if 14 copies were sold and the total value of the remaining books was 460 , how many paperback copies were sold ?

A. 10
B. 11
C. 12
D. 13
E. 9

message.content:
Total value 55 books: 10·20+45·10=650. Remaining 460, sold 190. Let p paperback sold: 20(14−p)+10p=190 → 280−10p=190 → p=9. E.</think>Total value = 10(20) + 45(10) = 650. Sold value = 650 − 460 = 190. With p paperbacks sold: 20(14−p) + 10p = 190 → 280 − 10p = 190 → p = 9.

ANSWER: E
